title.vi: Mặt nước quanh năm mùa khô (ao tôm, sông, kênh)
title.en: Standing water through the dry season (shrimp ponds, rivers, canals)

provenance.source: Landsat 5/7/8/9 C2 L2, January-April of each period
provenance.processing: share of 30 m cells under water (MNDWI > 0) in >= 75 % of their clear Jan-Apr looks (>= 5 looks), per ~250 m cell
provenance.attribution: Landsat 5/7/8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey
